test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six students Amit, Shivam, Dinesh, Kamlesh, Nihar and Roshan are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Amit is sitting to the immediate right of Shivam. Dinesh is sitting second to the right of Shivam. Nihar is an immediate neighbour of both Dinesh and Roshan. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Roshan?
solution: **Given: **Six students Amit, Shivam, Dinesh, Kamlesh, Nihar and Roshan are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Amit is sitting to the immediate right of Shivam. Dinesh is sitting second to the right of Shivam.
